outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic diagram of protein domains, not a plot presenting quantified data.
Panel B shows fluorescence micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel C is a scatter/mean plot showing mean ± SEM with individual cell data points overlaid as blue/light-blue circles, as stated in the caption.
Panel D shows mean ± SEM with individual cell fluorescence values overlaid as yellow circles, as described in the caption.
Panel E shows mean ± SEM of GFP+ percentage with individual biological replicate values overlaid as green dots.

Panel F (bar/scatter portion) shows mean ± SEM of inhibition zone with individual biological replicate values overlaid as gray dots; the accompanying disk images are photographs, not plots requiring individual points.
Panel G shows fluorescence micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel H shows mean ± SEM fluorescence intensity with individual cell values overlaid as blue circles.
Panel I shows mean ± SEM fluorescence intensity with individual cell values overlaid as yellow circles.
Panel J is a western blot image, not a plot of averaged data.
